items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued September 6 at 8:18PM EDT until September 7 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...Northern Outer Banks beaches.

* WHEN...From 8 AM EDT Monday through Monday evening.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The most likely time for strong rip
currents to occur is a couple hours either side of low tide,
which will occur around 10:18 AM Monday.
items.instruction:
Life-threatening rip currents. If caught in a rip current, remain
calm. Swim in a direction following the shoreline. If tired,
float or tread water until out of the rip current. If unable to
escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 6 at 2:57PM EDT until September 8 at 12:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt and seas
4 to 6 ft expected.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Duck to Oregon Inlet.

* WHEN...From 2 AM Monday to midnight EDT Monday night.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
